steps.action: Define the core functionality and requirements of the sample app.
steps.rationale: Understanding the basic requirements and functionality will provide a clear direction for the initial development phase.

steps.action: Develop a basic version of the sample app with essential features.
steps.rationale: Creating a minimum viable product (MVP) allows for early testing and feedback, ensuring the core features work as intended.

steps.action: Conduct testing and gather user feedback on the sample app.
steps.rationale: User feedback and testing will help identify areas for improvement and potential bugs, guiding the enhancement phase.

steps.action: Implement improvements and additional features based on feedback.
steps.rationale: Enhancing the app with new features and improvements will increase its value and usability, addressing user needs and expectations.

steps.action: Perform final testing and quality assurance.
steps.rationale: Ensuring the app is stable and meets quality standards is crucial before a wider release or deployment.
